item.title: Linux Tutorial for Beginners - Story Book Version
item.description: UNIX Introduction Reference: https://linuxtut.netlify.app/unixintro The UNIX operating system In the article, the author says that “The UNIX operating system is made up of three parts; the kernel, the shell and the programs.". Personally, I would like to add users to it. Login The flowchart below illustrates the process of a user logging into a UNIX system. The kernel verifies the username and password. If the credentials are correct, the user can start a program, which typically opens a shell.
